records.title: Warning: llama-perplexity cannot rank quant formats on hybrid-GDN models
records.summary: On Qwen3.8-27B (qwen3_5: 48 GDN + 16 full-attention layers), wikitext-2 PPL came back NON-monotonic in precision: Q4_K_M 6.547 < mixed 6.653 < Q8_0 6.678 < Q5_K_M 6.794. Root cause: the full-F16 reference scored 6.5545 - worse than Q4_K_M on 7/8 chunks and ~= Q8_0 - so the metric (recurrent-state accumulation), not the weights, is confounded; quant kernels exonerated. PPL also grows with chunk length (6.29 -> 7.15 at c2048 -> c8192). Upstream: ggml-org/llama.cpp#28879. Use per-position logit parity vs F16 for quality on linear-attention hybrids.

records.title: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 route (one B70): correctness, 262144 context, prefix cache
records.summary: Primary single-card Qwen3.8-27B route since the 2026-09-26/27 re-measure campaign (CAM-2026-AUTOROUND-VS-EXL3). Correctness: 6/6 exact-answer battery incl. code_execution 14/14 twice and clean replay - the only quantized arm to pass alongside OpenVINO int4. Context: the only arm at the native 262,144 boundary on one card - real 261,920-token prompt completed with correct needle retrieval (fp8 KV pool 287,040 tok @gmu 0.94; cold 258,480-tok prompt 389 s ~664 tok/s prefill; cached re-run 13-28 s). Host-executed task battery (cache ON): 8/10 on 5 bugfix + 5 codegen cases. Prefix cache: 10,546-token shared prefix 8.11 s cold -> ~1.5 s cached (5.4x, best of all arms). KV dtype is fp8-only (bf16 rejected by reshape_and_cache_flash). Effective decode bandwidth ~240-355 GB/s (150->230 W) - below OV int4's ~414 GB/s roofline band consistent with compute-bound trellis dequant on Xe2 (upstream hypothesis, unproven locally); EXL3 wins on correctness + capacity + footprint (15.7 GiB weights) instead.

Eval A = frozen wikitext-2 test slice, 1,664 scored positions; eval B = turboderp held-out chat trace (response positions only, not used for calibration), 1,531 positions. records.title: Qwen3.8-27B W4A16/GPTQ-family closure (defective class)
records.summary: Closed class for this hybrid model (CAM-2026-AUTOROUND-VS-EXL3). Three independent W4A16 exports all reproduce the exact same in-head-arithmetic defect (sum(i*i for i in range(4)) -> '30' instead of 14, deterministic): GPTQModel export (removed SergiioB checkpoint), dbirks AutoRound compressed-tensors, and a local AutoRound 0.14.2 auto_gptq artifact calibrated on a code-heavy corpus (128x1536, 200 iters). The BF16 base model is proven CORRECT via TP2 control (14/14 twice) - the defect is reproduced across all three tested W4A16 export paths, not the source weights (OpenVINO int4 is a different, unaffected quantization route). Measured speed is also the worst of the pack (~15-16.5 tok/s chunk-rate vs EXL3 ~24.6 and OV ~28.5) and 262,144 context is unreachable on one card (fp8 KV max ~211K, bf16 ~106K). Nuance: the defect is narrow - the local AutoRound arm scored 9/10 on host-executed real code tasks, so 'W4A16 is defective' does not mean 'broken for code authoring'.

records.title: Qwen3.8-27B OpenVINO GenAI INT4-GDN8 verified context envelope
records.summary: Capability note, no ranking metrics (P10 decision 2026-09-23): the n=3/n=5 evidence carries full-protocol cells but not every coordinate the benchmark class requires, so numbers below are descriptive. Verified context envelope on one B70 at the 230 W cap: full-protocol requests pass to 131,072 and 163,840 (163,840: 111 generated tokens, TTFT 395 s, 14.34 tok/s), and 196,608 and beyond are upstream-blocked (CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES, openvino.genai#4483) - single long generations pass at 196,608 (40/64/96-token runs) but the second long generation in the same process fails at 44 MiB free / 16 MiB largest free block, a per-generation growth bug rather than a capacity ceiling. Serving shape is an engine composite per the chart standard: grafted MTP5 draft arm to 65,536 (79.5 tok/s at 512, n=3, u8 KV) switching to the no-MTP u4-KV arm from 98,304 (17.2 tok/s at 98K down to 14.3 at 163,840, n=1 full-protocol ladder); the 196K-256K points quoted on other pages are 40-token capacity probes, not serving cells. Promotion to a ranked benchmark needs a re-measure with full coordinates (docs/qwen38-27b/RE-MEASURE-TASKS.md).

records.title: Qwen3.8-27B Cascadia qwen35 (own engine) capability
records.summary: Capability note for Cascadia as its own engine, never merged with OpenVINO GenAI (P10 decision 2026-09-23). The qwen35 backend (local Cascadia 0.2.3 rebuild wired to OpenVINO 2026.3.1) is the only loader for this VLM IR; the ov-genai backend SIGSEGVs in Tokenizer::setup_tokenizer on 2026.2 stock and on the 2026.3.1 rebuild. Measured n=5 at the 230 W cap on the same INT4-GDN8 1-stage shard: median wall decode 4.95 tok/s at P512/G128 (4.97 at P128, 4.92 at P1024, 4.77 at P512/G64, 5.04 at P512/G256), package power flat near 102 W so the cap stays unused, Tmax about 66 C, quality PASS on every cell. A plugin-hint A/B moved nothing (empty PluginConfig 4.95 = LATENCY+f16 4.95, THROUGHPUT 4.92): the ceiling is the host loop (host embed, f32 logits copy, host argmax), so closing the gap needs on-device argmax or ov-genai on OpenVINO 2026.5, not plugin strings. Grid cells lack measured prompt-token accounting and a pullable upstream build identity, so ranking metrics stay withheld pending re-measure (docs/qwen38-27b/RE-MEASURE-TASKS.md).

records.title: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 SC_5.00bpw_H6 context capacity (one B70): 190K+ achievable - 196,438 occupied tested; 131,072 higher-reserve alternate
records.summary: 190K+ context is achievable on SC5 for pure inference / headless use - tested 2026-10-14: 196,438 occupied tokens at the 196,608 stage (gmu 0.94, fp8 KV, native MTP3, single client, 1,069 MiB free) with exact needle retrieval at both depths (0.5 and 0.9) and exact warm multi-turn answers (CODE=/WORD=); every ladder stage 16K/32K/64K/131K/196K passed the same checks on staged real prompt + real output. 196K is the operator preference (launcher profile in progress) - 190K+ is supported, not untested. The 131,072 configuration is a higher-reserve alternate (130,872 occupied, 2,327 MiB free at gmu 0.90), not an engine cap. Headroom at 196K is low (1,069 MiB free): a low-headroom observation - fine for pure inference / headless work, not a general production recommendation. Engine budget: exact max seq 206,400 at gmu 0.94 (168,000 at gmu 0.90, 6.23 GiB KV) is a budget figure, NOT a completed request - the top budget cell was not completed (two client-side harness timeouts retained); 240K+ is beyond the SC5 budget (245,760+ would need gmu ~0.982, ~600 MiB free). The fp8 KV pool is one shared token budget (max_num_seqs 16): pool capacity is not context. Plain 4.00bpw (14.9 GiB vs SC5 20.09 GiB) is a separate route that reaches native 262,144 - do not merge the two. Sampling frozen greedy (temperature 0, top_p 1.0, thinking off, max_tokens 256) for the capacity cells: a capacity result only, NOT performance, and distinct from the recipe sampling (temp 0.7 / top_p 0.8 / top_k 20 / presence 1.5) used by the speed rows. Cache counters explicit: this image exposes no prefix-cache counters and no usage.prompt_tokens_details, so cold cells are zero-hit by construction only (unique entropy per request). Retained failures: two budget aborts (which produced the budget verdicts above), one bcs CAT/engine-reset host fault at SC5 weight upload (1 in 6 loads that day, copy-engine env set), two top-rung client timeouts.

records.title: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 SC_5.00bpw_H6 served quality: int8 vs fp16 prefill (one B70)
records.summary: As-served quality of exl3xpu's default W8A8 int8 prefill (EXL3_INT8_PREFILL=1) vs fp16 prefill on SC5, same image (2026-10-14). Prompt logprobs top-128 through /v1/completions, MTP and prefix caching off (hit delta 0), fp8 KV, prefill chunk 1024. Decision panel: 18 turboderp held-out chat rows (qbench_prompts_gen, response positions only, 44,473 per pass), two passes per server load. Coarse KL lower bound (reference top-128 plus one tail bucket, tail mass 0.0007) fp16 -> int8: 0.00099 [0.00092, 0.00107] on both passes, top-1 agreement 98.93 %, delta NLL +0.00065 / +0.00115 nats. Noise floor fp16 pass 1 -> pass 2: 0.00004 (cross-load 0.00003); int8 pass 1 -> pass 2: 0.00081. Predeclared rule: valid (floor <= 0.1x effect); effect / SC5 weight-quant KL on held-out chat (0.00141, record qwen38-27-exl3xpu-sc5-kl-screen) = 0.70 (CI low 0.65) -> material. Isolated probes found every prefill op bitwise repeatable; the run-to-run drift is upstream input differences amplified about 2x by int8 rounding, so determinism would not remove the shift. A first four-arm run is retained as invalid by its own determinism rule (diagnostic only). Decode path unchanged (int8 runs only on prompt chunks above 128 tokens). Not covered: fp8 KV error, task-level quality, other artifacts.
